title: अध्याय १०३

items.text:
अथ त्र्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
भानुतनुलेखनवर्णनम्
items.tr:
atha tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
bhānutanulekhanavarṇanam

items.speaker: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
अथ तस्मै ददौ कन्यां संज्ञां नाम विवस्वते ।
प्रसाद्य प्रणतो भूत्वा विश्वकर्मा प्रजापतिः ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
atha tasmai dadau kanyāṃ saṃjñāṃ nāma vivasvate |
prasādya praṇato bhūtvā viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ || 1 ||

items.text:
वैवस्वतस्तु सम्भूतो मनुस्तस्यां विवस्वतः ।
पूर्वमेव तथाख्यातं तत्स्वरूपं विशेषतः ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
vaivasvatastu sambhūto manustasyāṃ vivasvataḥ |
pūrvameva tathākhyātaṃ tatsvarūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2 ||

items.text:
(भूयस्तच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि मार्त्तण्डस्य महात्मनः ।
चरितं हन्ति यत्पापं कलौ संशृण्वतां नृणाम् ॥)
items.tr:
(bhūyastacchrotumicchāmi mārttaṇḍasya mahātmanaḥ |
caritaṃ hanti yatpāpaṃ kalau saṃśṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇām ||)
items.speaker: क्रौष्टुकिरुवाच
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
त्रीण्यपत्यान्यसौ तस्यां जनयामास गोपतिः ।
द्वौ पुत्रौ सुमहाभागो कन्यां च यमुनां मुने ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
trīṇyapatyānyasau tasyāṃ janayāmāsa gopatiḥ |
dvau putrau sumahābhāgo kanyāṃ ca yamunāṃ mune || 3 ||

items.text:
मनुर्वैवस्वतो ज्येष्ठः श्राद्धदेवः प्रजापतिः ।
ततो यमो यमी चैव यमलौ सम्बभूवतुः ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
manurvaivasvato jyeṣṭhaḥ śrāddhadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
tato yamo yamī caiva yamalau sambabhūvatuḥ || 4 ||

items.text:
यत्तेजोऽभ्यधिकं तस्य मार्तण्डस्य विवस्वतः ।
तेनातितापयामास त्रींल्लोकान्सचराचरान् ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
yattejo'bhyadhikaṃ tasya mārtaṇḍasya vivasvataḥ |
tenātitāpayāmāsa trīṃllokānsacarācarān || 5 ||

items.text:
गोलाकारं तु तद्दृष्ट्वा संज्ञारूपं विवस्वतः ।
असहन्ती महत्तेजः स्वां छायां प्रेक्ष्य साऽब्रवीत् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
golākāraṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā saṃjñārūpaṃ vivasvataḥ |
asahantī mahattejaḥ svāṃ chāyāṃ prekṣya sā'bravīt || 6 ||

items.text:
संज्ञोवाच
अहं यास्यामि भद्रं ते स्वमेव भवनं पितुः ।
निर्विकारं त्वयाप्यत्र स्थेयं मच्छासनाच्छुभे ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
saṃjñovāca
ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhadraṃ te svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ |
nirvikāraṃ tvayāpyatra stheyaṃ macchāsanācchubhe || 7 ||

items.text:
इमौ च बालकौ मह्यं कन्या च वरवर्णिनी ।
सम्भाव्यौ नैव चाख्येयमिदं भगवते त्वया ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
imau ca bālakau mahyaṃ kanyā ca varavarṇinī |
sambhāvyau naiva cākhyeyamidaṃ bhagavate tvayā || 8 ||

items.text:
छायोवाच
आकेशग्रहणाद्देवि आशपन्नैव कर्हिचित् ।
आख्यास्यामि मतं तुभ्यं गम्यतां यत्र वाञ्छितम् ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
chāyovāca
ākeśagrahaṇāddevi āśapannaiva karhicit |
ākhyāsyāmi mataṃ tubhyaṃ gamyatāṃ yatra vāñchitam || 9 ||

items.text:
इत्युक्ता छायया संज्ञा जगाम पितृमन्दिरम् ।
तत्रावसत्पितुर्गेहे कञ्चित्कालं शुभेक्षणा ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
ityuktā chāyayā saṃjñā jagāma pitṛmandiram |
tatrāvasatpiturgehe kañcitkālaṃ śubhekṣaṇā || 10 ||

items.text:
भर्तुः समीपं याहीति पित्रोक्ता सा पुनः पुनः ।
अगच्छद्वडवा भूत्वा कुरून्विप्रोत्तरांस्ततः ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
bhartuḥ samīpaṃ yāhīti pitroktā sā punaḥ punaḥ |
agacchadvaḍavā bhūtvā kurūnviprottarāṃstataḥ || 11 ||

items.text:
तत्र तेपे तपः साध्वी निराहारा महामुने ।
पितुः समीपं यातायाः संज्ञाया वाक्यतत्परा ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
tatra tepe tapaḥ sādhvī nirāhārā mahāmune |
pituḥ samīpaṃ yātāyāḥ saṃjñāyā vākyatatparā || 12 ||

items.text:
तद्रूपधारिणी छाया भास्करं समुपस्थिता ।
तस्यां च भगवान्सूर्यः संज्ञेयमिति चिन्तयन् ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
tadrūpadhāriṇī chāyā bhāskaraṃ samupasthitā |
tasyāṃ ca bhagavānsūryaḥ saṃjñeyamiti cintayan || 13 ||

items.text:
तथैव जनयामास द्वौ सुतौ कन्यकां तथा ।
पूर्वजस्य मनोस्तुल्यः सावर्णिस्तेन सोऽभवत् ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
tathaiva janayāmāsa dvau sutau kanyakāṃ tathā |
pūrvajasya manostulyaḥ sāvarṇistena so'bhavat || 14 ||

items.text:
यस्तयोः प्रथमं जातः पुत्रयोर्द्विजसत्तम ।
द्वितीयो योऽभवच्चान्यः स ग्रहोऽभूच्छनैश्चरः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
yastayoḥ prathamaṃ jātaḥ putrayordvijasattama |
dvitīyo yo'bhavaccānyaḥ sa graho'bhūcchanaiścaraḥ || 15 ||

items.text:
कन्याभूत्तपती या तां वव्रे संवरणो नृपः ।
संज्ञा तु पार्थिवी तेषामात्मजानां यथाऽकरोत् ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
kanyābhūttapatī yā tāṃ vavre saṃvaraṇo nṛpaḥ |
saṃjñā tu pārthivī teṣāmātmajānāṃ yathā'karot || 16 ||

items.text:
स्नेहान्न पूर्वजातानां तथा कृतवती सती ।
मनुस्तत्क्षान्तवांस्तस्या यमश्चास्या न चक्षमे ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
snehānna pūrvajātānāṃ tathā kṛtavatī satī |
manustatkṣāntavāṃstasyā yamaścāsyā na cakṣame || 17 ||

items.text:
बहुशो याच्यमानस्तु पितुः पत्न्या सुदुःखितः ।
स वै कोपाच्च बाल्याच्च भाविनोऽर्थस्य वै बलात् ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
bahuśo yācyamānastu pituḥ patnyā suduḥkhitaḥ |
sa vai kopācca bālyācca bhāvino'rthasya vai balāt || 18 ||

items.text:
पदा सन्तर्जयामास छायासंज्ञां यमो मुने ।
ततः शशाप च यमं संज्ञा सामर्षिणी भृशम् ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
padā santarjayāmāsa chāyāsaṃjñāṃ yamo mune |
tataḥ śaśāpa ca yamaṃ saṃjñā sāmarṣiṇī bhṛśam || 19 ||

items.text:
छायोवाच
पदा तर्जयसे यस्मात्पितृभार्यां गरीयसीम् ।
तस्मात्तवैव चरणः पतिष्यति न संशय ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
chāyovāca
padā tarjayase yasmātpitṛbhāryāṃ garīyasīm |
tasmāttavaiva caraṇaḥ patiṣyati na saṃśaya || 20 ||

items.text:
यमस्तु तेन शापेन भृशं पीडितमानसः ।
मनुना सह धर्मात्मा सर्वं पित्रे न्यवेदयत् ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
yamastu tena śāpena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ |
manunā saha dharmātmā sarvaṃ pitre nyavedayat || 21 ||

items.speaker: यम उवाच
items.text:
स्नेहेन तुल्यमस्मासु माता देव न वर्तते ।
विसृज्य ज्यायसोऽप्यस्मान्कनीयांसौ बुभूर्षति ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
snehena tulyamasmāsu mātā deva na vartate |
visṛjya jyāyaso'pyasmānkanīyāṃsau bubhūrṣati || 22 ||

items.text:
तस्यां मयोद्यतः पादो न तु देहे निपातितः ।
बाल्याद्वा यदि वा मोहात्तद्भवान्क्षन्तुमर्हति ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
tasyāṃ mayodyataḥ pādo na tu dehe nipātitaḥ |
bālyādvā yadi vā mohāttadbhavānkṣantumarhati || 23 ||

items.text:
शप्तोऽहं तात कोपेन जनन्या तनयो यतः ।
ततो न मन्ये जननीमिमां वै तपतां वर ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
śapto'haṃ tāta kopena jananyā tanayo yataḥ |
tato na manye jananīmimāṃ vai tapatāṃ vara || 24 ||

items.text:
विगुणेष्वपि पुत्रेषु न माता विगुणा पितः ।
पादस्ते पततां पुत्र कथमेतत्प्रवक्ष्यति ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
viguṇeṣvapi putreṣu na mātā viguṇā pitaḥ |
pādaste patatāṃ putra kathametatpravakṣyati || 25 ||

items.text:
तव प्रसादाच्चरणो न पतेद्भगवन्यथा ।
मातृशापादयं मेऽद्य तथा चिन्तय गोपते ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
tava prasādāccaraṇo na patedbhagavanyathā |
mātṛśāpādayaṃ me'dya tathā cintaya gopate || 26 ||

items.text:
असंशयमिदं पुत्र भविष्यत्यत्र कारणम् ।
येन त्वामाविशत्क्रोधो धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम् ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
asaṃśayamidaṃ putra bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam |
yena tvāmāviśatkrodho dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam || 27 ||
items.speaker: रविरुवाच

items.text:
सर्वेषामेव शापानां प्रतिघातो हि विद्यते ।
न तु मात्राभिशप्तानां क्वचिच्छापनिवर्तनम् ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
sarveṣāmeva śāpānāṃ pratighāto hi vidyate |
na tu mātrābhiśaptānāṃ kvacicchāpanivartanam || 28 ||

items.text:
न शक्यमेतन्मिथ्या तु कर्तुं मातुर्वचस्तव ।
किञ्चित्तव विधास्यामि पुत्रस्नेहादनुग्रहम् ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
na śakyametanmithyā tu kartuṃ māturvacastava |
kiñcittava vidhāsyāmi putrasnehādanugraham || 29 ||

items.text:
कृमयो मांसमादाय प्रयास्यन्ति महीतलम् ।
कृतं तस्या वचः सत्यं त्वं च त्रातो भविष्यसि ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
kṛmayo māṃsamādāya prayāsyanti mahītalam |
kṛtaṃ tasyā vacaḥ satyaṃ tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi || 30 ||

items.speaker: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
आदित्यस्त्वब्रवीच्छायां किमर्थं तनयेषु वै ।
तुल्येष्वप्यधिकः स्नेह एकत्र क्रियते त्वया ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
ādityastvabravīcchāyāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai |
tulyeṣvapyadhikaḥ sneha ekatra kriyate tvayā || 31 ||

items.text:
नूनं नैषां त्वं जननी संज्ञा कापि त्वमागता ।
विगुणेष्वप्यपत्येषु कथं माता शपेत्सुतम् ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
nūnaṃ naiṣāṃ tvaṃ jananī saṃjñā kāpi tvamāgatā |
viguṇeṣvapyapatyeṣu kathaṃ mātā śapetsutam || 32 ||

items.speaker: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
सा तत्परिहरन्ती च नाचचक्षे विवस्वतः ।
स चात्मानं समाधाय युक्तस्तत्त्वमपश्यत ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr:
sā tatpariharantī ca nācacakṣe vivasvataḥ |
sa cātmānaṃ samādhāya yuktastattvamapaśyata || 33 ||

items.text:
तं शप्तुमुद्यतं दृष्ट्वा छायासंज्ञा दिवस्पतिम् ।
भयेन कंपिता ब्रह्मन्यथावृत्तं न्यवेदयत् ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
taṃ śaptumudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā chāyāsaṃjñā divaspatim |
bhayena kaṃpitā brahmanyathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayat || 34 ||

items.text:
विवस्वांस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः श्रुत्वा श्वशुरमभ्यगात् ।
स चापि तं तथान्यामर्चयित्वा दिवाकरम् ॥
निर्दग्धुकामं रोषेण सान्त्वयामास सुव्रतः ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
vivasvāṃstu tataḥ kruddhaḥ śrutvā śvaśuramabhyagāt |
sa cāpi taṃ tathānyāmarcayitvā divākaram ||
nirdagdhukāmaṃ roṣeṇa sāntvayāmāsa suvrataḥ || 35 ||

items.text:
विश्वकर्मोवाच
तवातितेजसा व्याप्तमिदं रूपं सुदुःसहम् ।
असहन्ती ततः संज्ञा वने चरति वै तपः ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
viśvakarmovāca
tavātitejasā vyāptamidaṃ rūpaṃ suduḥsaham |
asahantī tataḥ saṃjñā vane carati vai tapaḥ || 36 ||

items.text:
द्रक्ष्यते तां भवानद्य स्वभार्यां शुभचारिणीम् ।
रूपार्थं भवतोऽरण्ये चरन्तीं समुहत्तपः ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
drakṣyate tāṃ bhavānadya svabhāryāṃ śubhacāriṇīm |
rūpārthaṃ bhavato'raṇye carantīṃ samuhattapaḥ || 37 ||

items.text:
स्मृतं मे ब्रह्मणो वाक्यं यदि ते देव रोचते ।
रूपं निवर्तयाम्येतत्तव कान्तं दिवस्पते ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
smṛtaṃ me brahmaṇo vākyaṃ yadi te deva rocate |
rūpaṃ nivartayāmyetattava kāntaṃ divaspate || 38 ||

items.speaker: मार्कण्डेय उवाच
items.text:
यतो हि भास्वतो रूपं प्रागासीत्परिमण्डलम् ।
ततस्तथेति तं प्राह त्वष्टारं भगवान्रविः ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
yato hi bhāsvato rūpaṃ prāgāsītparimaṇḍalam |
tatastatheti taṃ prāha tvaṣṭāraṃ bhagavānraviḥ || 39 ||

items.text:
विश्वकर्मा त्वनुज्ञातः शाकद्वीपे विवस्वतः ।
भ्रमिमारोप्य तत्तेजः शातनायोपचक्रमे ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
viśvakarmā tvanujñātaḥ śākadvīpe vivasvataḥ |
bhramimāropya tattejaḥ śātanāyopacakrame || 40 ||

items.text:
भ्रमताऽशेषजगतां नाभिभूतेन भास्वता ।
समुद्राद्रिवनोपेता सा रुरोह मही नभः ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
bhramatā'śeṣajagatāṃ nābhibhūtena bhāsvatā |
samudrādrivanopetā sā ruroha mahī nabhaḥ || 41 ||

items.text:
गगनं चाखिलं ब्रह्मन्सचन्द्रग्रहतारकम् ।
अधोगतं महाभाग बभूवाक्षिक्षमाकुलम् ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
gaganaṃ cākhilaṃ brahmansacandragrahatārakam |
adhogataṃ mahābhāga babhūvākṣikṣamākulam || 42 ||

items.text:
विक्षिप्तसलिलाः सर्वे बभूवुश्च तथाब्धितः ।
व्यभिद्यन्त महाशैलाः शीर्णसानुनिबन्धनाः ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
vikṣiptasalilāḥ sarve babhūvuśca tathābdhitaḥ |
vyabhidyanta mahāśailāḥ śīrṇasānunibandhanāḥ || 43 ||

items.text:
ध्रुवाधाराण्यशेषाणि धिष्ण्यानि मुनिसत्तम ।
त्रुट्यद्रश्मिनिबन्धानि ह्यधो जग्मुः सहस्रशः ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr:
dhruvādhārāṇyaśeṣāṇi dhiṣṇyāni munisattama |
truṭyadraśminibandhāni hyadho jagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 44 ||

items.text:
वेगभ्रमणसंजात वायुक्षिप्ताः समन्ततः ।
व्यशीर्यन्त महामेघा घोररावविराविणः ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
vegabhramaṇasaṃjāta vāyukṣiptāḥ samantataḥ |
vyaśīryanta mahāmeghā ghorarāvavirāviṇaḥ || 45 ||

items.text:
भास्वद्भ्रमणविभ्रान्तं भूम्याकाशरसातलम् ।
जगादाकुलमत्यर्थं तदासीन्मुनिसत्तम ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
bhāsvadbhramaṇavibhrāntaṃ bhūmyākāśarasātalam |
jagādākulamatyarthaṃ tadāsīnmunisattama || 46 ||

items.text:
त्रैलोक्ये सकले विप्र भ्रममाणे सुरर्षयः ।
देवाश्च ब्रह्मणा सार्द्धं भास्वन्तमभितुष्टुवुः ॥ ४७ ॥
items.tr:
trailokye sakale vipra bhramamāṇe surarṣayaḥ |
devāśca brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ bhāsvantamabhituṣṭuvuḥ || 47 ||

items.text:
आदिदेवोऽसि देवानां ज्ञातमेतत्स्वरूपतः ।
स्वर्गस्थित्यन्तकालेषु त्रिधा भेदेन तिष्ठसि ॥ ४८ ॥
items.tr:
ādidevo'si devānāṃ jñātametatsvarūpataḥ |
svargasthityantakāleṣu tridhā bhedena tiṣṭhasi || 48 ||

items.text:
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु जगन्नाथ धर्मवर्षाहिमाकर ।
जुषस्व शान्तिं लोकानां देवदेव दिवाकर ॥ ४९ ॥
items.tr:
svasti te'stu jagannātha dharmavarṣāhimākara |
juṣasva śāntiṃ lokānāṃ devadeva divākara || 49 ||

items.text:
इन्द्रश्चागत्य तं देवं लिख्यमानं यथाऽस्तुवत् ।
जयदेव जगद्वयापिञ्जयाशेषजगत्पते ॥ ५० ॥
items.tr:
indraścāgatya taṃ devaṃ likhyamānaṃ yathā'stuvat |
jayadeva jagadvayāpiñjayāśeṣajagatpate || 50 ||

items.text:
ऋषयश्च ततः सप्त वसिष्ठात्रिपुरोगमाः ।
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैः स्वस्ति स्वस्तीति वादिनः ॥ ५१ ॥
items.tr:
ṛṣayaśca tataḥ sapta vasiṣṭhātripurogamāḥ |
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ svasti svastīti vādinaḥ || 51 ||

items.text:
वेदोक्ताभिरथाग्र्याभिर्वालखिल्याश्च तुष्टुवुः ।
भास्वन्तमृग्भिराद्याभिर्लिख्यमानं मुदायुताः ॥ ५२ ॥
items.tr:
vedoktābhirathāgryābhirvālakhilyāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ |
bhāsvantamṛgbhirādyābhirlikhyamānaṃ mudāyutāḥ || 52 ||

items.text:
त्वं नाथ मोक्षिणां मोक्षो ध्येयस्त्वं ध्यानिनां परः ।
त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानां कर्मकाण्डेऽपि वर्तताम् ॥ ५३ ॥
items.tr:
tvaṃ nātha mokṣiṇāṃ mokṣo dhyeyastvaṃ dhyānināṃ paraḥ |
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ karmakāṇḍe'pi vartatām || 53 ||

items.text:
शं प्रजाभ्योऽस्तु देवेश शन्नोऽस्तु जगतांपते ।
शन्नोऽस्तु द्विपदे नित्यं शन्नश्चास्तु चतुष्पदे ॥ ५४ ॥
items.tr:
śaṃ prajābhyo'stu deveśa śanno'stu jagatāṃpate |
śanno'stu dvipade nityaṃ śannaścāstu catuṣpade || 54 ||

items.text:
ततो विद्याधरगणा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः ।
कृताञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे शिरोभिः प्रणता रविम् ॥ ५५ ॥
items.tr:
tato vidyādharagaṇā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ |
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve śirobhiḥ praṇatā ravim || 55 ||

items.text:
ऊचुरेवंविधा वाचो मनः श्रोत्रसुखावहः ।
सह्यं भवतु ते तेजो भूतानां भूतभावन ॥ ५६ ॥
items.tr:
ūcurevaṃvidhā vāco manaḥ śrotrasukhāvahaḥ |
sahyaṃ bhavatu te tejo bhūtānāṃ bhūtabhāvana || 56 ||

items.text:
ततो हाहा हुहूश्चैव नारदस्तुम्बुरुस्तथा ।
उपगायितुमारब्धा गान्धर्वं कुशला रविम् ॥ ५७ ॥
items.tr:
tato hāhā huhūścaiva nāradastumburustathā |
upagāyitumārabdhā gāndharvaṃ kuśalā ravim || 57 ||

items.text:
षड्जमध्यमगान्धारग्रामत्रयविशारदाः ।
मूर्च्छनाभिश्च तानैश्च सम्प्रयोगैः सुखप्रदम् ॥ ५८ ॥
items.tr:
ṣaḍjamadhyamagāndhāragrāmatrayaviśāradāḥ |
mūrcchanābhiśca tānaiśca samprayogaiḥ sukhapradam || 58 ||

items.text:
विश्वाची च घृताची च उर्वश्यथ तिलोत्तमा ।
मेनका सहजन्या च रम्भा चाप्सरसां वरा ॥ ५९ ॥
items.tr:
viśvācī ca ghṛtācī ca urvaśyatha tilottamā |
menakā sahajanyā ca rambhā cāpsarasāṃ varā || 59 ||

items.text:
ननृतुर्जगतामीशे लिख्यमाने विभावसौ ।
ज्ञानभावविलासाढ्यात्कुर्वन्तोऽभिनयान्बहून् ॥ ६० ॥
items.tr:
nanṛturjagatāmīśe likhyamāne vibhāvasau |
jñānabhāvavilāsāḍhyātkurvanto'bhinayānbahūn || 60 ||

items.text:
प्रावाद्यन्त ततस्तत्र वेणुवीणादिझर्झराः ।
पणवाः पुष्कराश्चैव मृदङ्गा पटहानकाः ॥ ६१ ॥
items.tr:
prāvādyanta tatastatra veṇuvīṇādijharjharāḥ |
paṇavāḥ puṣkarāścaiva mṛdaṅgā paṭahānakāḥ || 61 ||

items.text:
देवदुन्दुभयः शङ्खाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
गायद्भिश्चैव गान्धर्वं नृत्यद्भिश्चाप्सरोगणैः ॥ ६२ ॥
items.tr:
devadundubhayaḥ śaṅkhāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
gāyadbhiścaiva gāndharvaṃ nṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ || 62 ||

items.text:
तूर्यवादित्रघोषैश्च सर्वं कोलाहलीकृतम् ।
ततः कृताञ्जलिपुटा भक्तिनम्रात्ममूर्तयः ॥ ६३ ॥
items.tr:
tūryavāditraghoṣaiśca sarvaṃ kolāhalīkṛtam |
tataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhaktinamrātmamūrtayaḥ || 63 ||

items.text:
लिख्यमानं सहस्रांशुं प्रणेमुः सर्वदेवताः ।
ततः कोलाहले तस्मिन्सर्वदेवसमागमे ॥
तेजसः शातनं चक्रे विश्वकर्मा शनैः शनैः ॥ ६४ ॥
items.tr:
likhyamānaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ praṇemuḥ sarvadevatāḥ |
tataḥ kolāhale tasminsarvadevasamāgame ||
tejasaḥ śātanaṃ cakre viśvakarmā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 64 ||

items.text:
इति हिमजलघर्मकालहेतोर्हरकमलासनविष्णुसंस्तुतस्य ।
तनुपरिलिखनं निशम्य भानोर्व्रजति दिवाकरलोकमायुषोऽन्ते ॥ ६५ ॥
items.tr:
iti himajalagharmakālahetorharakamalāsanaviṣṇusaṃstutasya |
tanuparilikhanaṃ niśamya bhānorvrajati divākaralokamāyuṣo'nte || 65 ||

en_summary: Markandeya tells Kraushtuki that Vishvakarma the Prajapati, bowing and seeking the Sun's favour, gave him his daughter Sanjna in marriage, and from her Vivasvat had Vaivasvata Manu, as told before. (An unnumbered verse follows in which Kraushtuki asks to hear again the story of Martanda, which destroys the sins of those who hear it in the Kali age.) Markandeya says the Sun had three children by her: two sons and the daughter Yamuna. The eldest was Vaivasvata Manu, the Shraddhadeva and a Prajapati; then the twins Yama and Yami were born. Martanda's very great brightness scorched the three worlds. Seeing the Sun's ball-shaped form and unable to bear his brightness, Sanjna looked at her shadow (Chhaya) and told her: she would go to her father's house; Chhaya should stay here unchanged at her order, care for the two boys and the lovely girl, and not tell the Lord. Chhaya said she would never tell until seized by the hair or cursed, and told her to go where she wished. Sanjna went to her father's house and stayed for some time; told again and again by her father to go back to her husband, she became a mare and went to the Northern Kurus, where the virtuous woman did penance without food. Chhaya, obedient to Sanjna, took her form and went to the Sun, who, thinking she was Sanjna, had by her two sons and a daughter. The first son was like the elder Manu and so became Savarni; the second became the planet Shanaishchara (Saturn); the daughter, Tapati, was chosen as wife by King Samvarana. Chhaya-Sanjna did not show the elder children the same love as her own; Manu bore this, but Yama did not. Pained by her repeated slights, from anger, from childishness and by the force of what was to be, Yama threatened her with his foot, and she angrily cursed him: since he threatened his father's honoured wife with his foot, that foot would surely fall. Deeply troubled, the righteous Yama, with Manu, told his father everything: their mother did not love them equally, but put the elder ones aside and wanted to favour the younger; he had raised his foot at her but had not brought it down on her body, from childishness or confusion, and his father should forgive this; since his mother cursed her son in anger, he did not think she was really his mother, for a mother is not cruel even to bad sons; he asked his father to find a way, by his grace, that his foot would not fall through this curse. The Sun said there must be a reason why anger entered him, who knew dharma and spoke the truth; there is a remedy for every curse, but never a way to undo a curse from a mother; her word cannot be made false, but out of love he would do him a favour: worms would take flesh from his foot and go to the ground, so her word would come true and he would be saved. The Sun then asked Chhaya why she loved one child more than others who were equal; surely she was not their mother but some other Sanjna who had come, for how could a mother curse her son even if he was bad? She avoided the question and did not tell him, so he looked within by meditation and saw the truth. When he was about to curse her, Chhaya-Sanjna, shaking with fear, told him what had happened. Angry, the Sun went to his father-in-law, who honoured him and calmed him as he was about to burn everything in his rage. Vishvakarma said that the Sun's form, filled with too much brightness, was very hard to bear; unable to bear it, Sanjna was doing penance in the forest; he would see his virtuous wife today, doing great penance in the forest for the sake of his form; recalling Brahma's words, Vishvakarma offered, if the Sun agreed, to make his form pleasing. Since the Sun's form had earlier been perfectly round, the Sun agreed. With his permission, Vishvakarma, in Shaka-dvipa, put the Sun on his lathe (bhrami) to trim his brightness. As the Sun, the centre of all worlds, was turned, the earth with its seas, mountains and forests rose into the sky, and the whole sky with the moon, planets and stars went down, shaken; the oceans spilled their waters, great mountains split with their peaks broken, the stars held by Dhruva (the pole star) fell by thousands as the bonds of their rays snapped, and great clouds, hurled by the wind of the fast turning, burst with terrible roars; the earth, sky and underworld were thrown into great confusion by the Sun's turning. While the three worlds spun, the divine sages and gods with Brahma praised the Sun: he is the first god of the gods, and in creation, preservation and the end he stands in three forms; they wished him well, the maker of dharma, rain and cold, and asked him to bring peace to the worlds. Indra came and praised him as he was being trimmed: 'Victory, O god who pervades the world, lord of all worlds.' The seven sages led by Vasishtha and Atri praised him with many hymns, saying 'Svasti, svasti'; the Valakhilyas joyfully praised him with the foremost Vedic Rig verses: he is the liberation of those seeking liberation, the highest object of the meditators, the refuge of all beings; may there be peace (sham) for all creatures, for two-footed and four-footed beings. The vidyadharas, yakshas, rakshasas and snakes, with joined palms and bowed heads, asked that his brightness become bearable for beings. Haha, Huhu, Narada and Tumburu, skilled in music and the three scales (shadja, madhyama and gandhara), with their modes and melodies, began to sing to him; the apsaras Vishvachi, Ghritachi, Urvashi, Tilottama, Menaka, Sahajanya and Rambha danced with many gestures; flutes, vinas, cymbals, drums of many kinds, divine kettledrums and conches sounded by hundreds and thousands, and all became a great noise. With joined palms, bowed in devotion, all the gods bowed to the thousand-rayed Sun as he was being trimmed, and amid that tumult of the assembled gods Vishvakarma slowly cut down his brightness. Whoever hears this account of the trimming of the body of the Sun, the cause of the seasons of cold, rain and heat, praised by Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu, goes at the end of life to the world of the Sun.
